system.description: By spending a Blood Trait, the Baali conjures a bolt of eerie black flame and hurls it at an enemy in a Physical aggravated Challenge; a successful hit inflicts an aggravated wound before the flame gutters out. The Baali may instead spend a Blood Trait each turn to sustain the flame on a target within sight, inflicting an additional aggravated wound each turn she maintains concentration. Onlookers must make Courage tests to avoid @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference.JournalEntry.7f69a74f36db4a08]{Rotschreck} as with any large flame, and the target may dodge as with any ranged attack.
